in_sanskrit.name: मानहर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Manhar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'manas' meaning mind and 'har' meaning to take or to possess. Thus, Manhar can be interpreted as one who is dear to the mind or one who is loved and cherished by the mind.

in_hindi.name: मानहर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Manhar in Hindi translates to 'beloved' or 'dear one'. It can also mean 'one who is loved and cherished' or 'one who is close to the heart'.

in_tamil.name: மாணர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Manhar can be translated to 'valiththar' or 'valithar' which means 'beloved' or 'dear one'. Another interpretation is 'alivilan' which means 'one who is dear to the heart'.

in_telugu.name: మెయ్యళహద్దోపదేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Manhar can be translated to 'meyyudu' which means 'beloved' or 'dear one'. Another interpretation is 'deshik' which means 'one who is devoted to the lord' or 'one who serves the lord'.

in_marathi.name: Manhar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manhar is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘manas’, meaning ‘mind’. The suffix ‘har’ means ‘moon-like’, symbolizing one who is calm, steady, and wise like the moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon is also a symbol of the mind.
